findings.summary: the gate pins a Go package and function the brief never names: oracle.go imports github.com/mvelosop/vloop/internal/budget and calls budget.Check(pluginDir string) []string, so a correct L10 test placed or named differently fails to build

notes: T9: L10 asks for a test beside its ceilings that fails with the message "plan: 4,213 words, over its ceiling of 4,100"; the brief names no package or function, so the gate should judge through what the brief pins (the real skills counted by the gate, and the message) rather than a Go API. The other 12 gates fail on the base at behavioural assertions (T3, T6, T12 on absent text or files; T4, T5, T8, T10, T11 at the missing warning, doctor line, instructions line and defect report); their fixtures and matchers, and the real-data expectations of T4 and T13 against the four consumed briefs, were checked and hold.
